lastCompletedStory.title: Refuse to arm the recycle marker when no live watcher is running

nextStoryContext: US-001 adds exit code 4 to dispatchJournal (watcher-absent path). US-002 or later stories in this PRD that reference the exit-4 contract can rely on it being distinct from exit-1 (invalid-stdin/append-fail) and exit-3 (handoff-absent). The watcherAlive() composite helper now lives in src/supervisor/sidecar-pid.ts and is tested via injection (watcherAliveFn dep on JournalDispatchDeps). File-size ceiling for sidecar-pid.ts raised to 158 (was 144) with CAM-168 ref in _ref field.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Signal 0 confirms process existence without sending a real signal; throws on dead pid (ESRCH); EPERM means alive-but-unpermissioned. Existing sidecarPidAlive() implementation is correct; watcherAlive() correctly delegates to it.
